signals.detail: 9 distinct design tells: reflex-font, glass-panel, pill-everything, ai-violet, radial-spotlight-glow, thin-border-wide-shadow, icon-tile-stack, reflex-font-2, icon-tile-grid
score 0.00, not typical of what Claude builds for this brief

actions.what: Write art-direction.json: run craft direction init, then give every choice a reason from the client's world.
Pick the display face from the client's world (signage, packaging, the trade's lettering), record why in art-direction.json, and keep it unique across the estate.
actions.why: Reflex font (reflex-font, gen 1), in source and on the page; Second-wave reflex font (reflex-font-2, gen 2)

actions.what: Derive the accent from something the client owns (livery, shopfront, product). If violet is the brand, declare it: `{ "tell": "ai-violet", "because": "..." }`.
actions.why: Indigo-violet accent (ai-violet, gen 1), in source and on the page

actions.what: Give text a solid ground, or crop the image so the text sits on a quiet area.
actions.why: Glass panel (glass-panel, gen 1); Radial glow (radial-spotlight-glow, gen 2), in source and on the page; Icon in a tinted tile (icon-tile-stack, gen 2)

actions.what: Pick one: a border that is visible, or a shadow the light source explains. Keep within the four-shadow budget.
actions.why: Hairline border, wide shadow (thin-border-wide-shadow, gen 2), in source and on the page

actions.what: Choose the shape language on purpose (and record it), then use the pill only where it means something. The limit here is 30 per scan.
Show the services as the client would: a price list, a menu board, photographs of the work, a sequence.
Use a full stop, a comma, or a colon. Two sentences are clearer than one sentence with a dash in it.
actions.why: Em dash (em-dash), 72 places, first at apps/portal/scripts/parity-test-db.ts:141

actions.what: Say the plain thing. 'Elevate your look' becomes what actually happens: 'Gel that lasts three weeks'.
Name the action and the outcome: 'Book a 45-minute facial', not 'Experience the difference'.
Say the positive claim and drop the contrast.
Replace the phrase with the fact behind it: a number, a name, a place, a time.
Keep the one that lands hardest and cut the rest. 'What is genuinely excellent' reads better as 'what is excellent'.

actions.why: Rhetorical question opener (rhetorical-opener), 8 places, first at apps/web/src/app/[locale]/resources/[slug]/page.tsx:206

actions.what: Replace it with the positive fact it hints at, or cut it.
actions.why: 'No X' badge (no-x-badge), 4 places, first at apps/web/src/lib/email.test.ts:433

actions.what: Say what they get: 'We reply within a day and only about your enquiry'.
actions.why: 'No X, no Y' list (no-x-no-y), 2 places, first at scripts/guards/portal-route-contract.mjs:191

actions.what: Say what is actually true. 'World-class service' becomes 'We answer the phone until 8pm'. 'Reach out' becomes 'get in touch'.
Remove it. Typographic marks are fine: a star for a rating, a middot as a separator, an arrow in a link.
actions.why: Emoji in copy (emoji), 4 places, first at Social/SEN-Sphere-Instagram-Launch/CAPTIONS.md:10
